_about: Named engine profiles for collect.py / perfomance_nonces.py / quality_gsm8k.py / pair_report.sh (--profile NAME). Each: eager=graph(false)/eager(true); args=extra vllm-serve flags appended to the PoC defaults; env=extra env vars (rarely needed). Attention backend is a SERVE FLAG (--attention-backend, works local AND remote) — not an env var. deploy_from_args verifies the engaged backend matches the request (fails loudly on silent fallback). Effective config is recorded per-run in provenance.
